mobilesupport.faqsSubtitle: Quick answers to the most common topics
mobilesupport.faqCreateAccountQ: How do I create an account?
mobilesupport.faqCreateAccountA: In the app, tap "Sign up" and enter your email address. We'll send a confirmation link. Once confirmed, you can complete your profile.
mobilesupport.faqResetPasswordQ: How do I reset my password?
mobilesupport.faqResetPasswordA: On the sign-in screen tap "Forgot password" and enter your email. You'll receive a reset link within a few minutes — it expires after 24 hours.
mobilesupport.faqUpdateProfileQ: How do I update my profile?
mobilesupport.faqUpdateProfileA: Open your profile and tap "Edit". You can change your display name, bio, profile picture and interests. Changes save automatically.
mobilesupport.faqPaymentMethodsA: Visa, Mastercard and American Express via our secure Stripe integration. Apple Pay and Google Pay are also available on supported devices.
mobilesupport.faqDataSecureA: Yes. We use end-to-end encryption, secure authentication and follow GDPR. We never share your data with third parties without your consent.
mobilesupport.faqDeleteAccountQ: How do I delete my account?
mobilesupport.faqDeleteAccountA: Go to Settings → Account and tap "Delete account". We process deletion requests within 30 days.
